verdict.rationale: The 01 is an agent platform that executes tasks, so per-run metrics such as success, duration and token or dollar cost are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions run metrics, cost reporting or run comparison. The evidence covers only voice interfaces, server variants, clients, hardware and profile customization.

support.subject: As an operator, per-run metrics (success, duration, token or dollar cost) are reported, so I can compare runs
